name: updateLocationFieldValue
description: Sets a location's value for one of the plugin's own location fields, such as its booking email.

title.description: The exact title of the location.

fieldLabel.description: The label of the location field, as shown in the plugin's settings.

value.description: The field's value, such as an email address, phone number, website or text. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

customLabel.description: The location's own label for the field, where the field allows one. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when the value is set.

error.description: Why it wasn't set, such as no field having that label or a value that isn't an email address.

value.description: The value now set, if any.

customLabel.description: The custom label now set, if any.
